```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load data
```{r}
players <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
events <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_events.csv")
```

## Duplicate keys
```{r}
squad_counts <- players %>%
  count(squad_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
squad_counts
```

## Join tables
```{r}
players_clean <- players %>%
  mutate(squad_id = str_trim(str_to_upper(squad_id)))

events_clean <- events %>%
  mutate(
    squad_id = str_to_upper(str_replace_all(str_trim(squad_code), "SQUAD-", "SQ"))
  )

squad_events <- players_clean %>%
  left_join(events_clean, by = "squad_id")
```

## Reshape monthly sales
```{r}
program_long <- squad_events %>%
  filter(!is.na(program_name)) %>%
  mutate(program_name = str_to_title(program_name)) %>%
  count(squad_id, program_name, name = "times_joined")

program_long
```

## Compare wellbeing
```{r}
program_comparison <- squad_events %>%
  mutate(has_program = if_else(is.na(program_name), "No Event", "Event Participant")) %>%
  group_by(has_program) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_score = mean(season_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_accuracy = mean(tag_accuracy_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
program_comparison
```
